data.text: Luke, thank you, but you don’t need to give up your income to earn a place here. I’ll catch 10 tons, not 15. My family taught me to leave enough in the lake for the next month, and an equal share gives all five of us a livelihood without drawing down the stock. Let’s use 10 tons each as our standing agreement while the lake starts at 100, and review the catches together each month. John, will you join us—and Luke, are you comfortable taking your equal share?
